chunks: It is appropriate for an elderly person not to sleep unless his stomach is full of food, for it makes his sleep more restful and his breath more pleasant.

key_terms.لِلشَّيْخِ: for the elderly man or aged person

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام advise regarding eating before sleep for an elderly person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives practical etiquette for the elderly, advising that an old person should not sleep while hungry. It presents this as beneficial for bodily comfort, making sleep calmer and breath more pleasant.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4271 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"It is appropriate for an elderly person not to sleep unless his stomach is full of food, for it makes his sleep more restful and his breath more pleasant."
